CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC:40480 Siddesh H vs State Of Karnataka on 27 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169027853/
2  CRL.P No. 469 of 2022  ORAL ORDER 1.

Heard the learned counsel Sri.Chakravarthy T.S., appearing for the petitioners and the learned counsel Smt.Sowmya R., learned HCGP for respondent No.1 and Sri.R.B.Deshpande, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2.

2. Criminal Petition No.469 of 2022 is filed calling in question the proceedings initiated in Crime No.68 of 2021 on the file of the 2nd Additional Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) and J.M.F.C Court, Davanagere District for offences punishable under Sections 506, 34, 498A, 504, 307, 323 of IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, against the petitioners--accused Nos.1 to 6.
3.
During the pendency of the present petition, the parties have resolved the dispute among them.

A compromise petition dated 27.09.2024 has been filed before this Court under Section 320 of Cr.P.C., seeking compounding of the offences, along with the joint affidavit NC: 2024:KHC:40480 filed by the petitioners and respondent No.2.
The compromise petition and joint affidavit are taken on record.
4. The settlement also recognizes co-operation for withdrawal of the cases pending against the petitioners.
One of which is the present impugned proceedings.

The settlement insofar as narrates about the present proceedings, read as follows:
"APPLICATION FOR COMPOUNDING OFFENCE UNDER SECTION 320 R/W 482 OF Cr. PC 1973 It is respectfully submitted as follows:-
1.

That the petitioners the petitioners are seeking quashing criminal proceedings initiated in Crime No. 68 of 2021 on the file of the 2nd Addl Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) &
JMFC Court Davangere Dist for the offence punishable under section 506, 34, 498A,
504, 307, 323 IPC and Under section 3 & 4 Dowry Prohibition Act., pursuant to the criminal proceedings initiated by the Respondent No. 2/Complainant.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. That the petitioner No. 1 got married to the Complaint on 24.11.2019.
Subsequent to the marriage petitioner No. 1 and Complaint/respondent No. 2 started to reside together in Bengaluru.

During the stay, petitioner No. 1 was using the laptop NC:
2024:KHC:40480 belonging to the complaint and in the laptop he came across obscene scenes containing nudity and sexual acts 3.

Based on the said complaint dated 26.04.2021, the Jurisdictional Police registered FIR in Crime No. 68 of 2021 for the offence punishable under section 506, 34, 498A,
504, 307, 323 IPC and Under section 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

sentences.text: That the Petitioners and the Respondent No. 2 in the above case are persons of the deferent village.
The Petitioner 1 to 6 herein and the Complainant/Respondent No. 2 have compromised and settled their above case due to the intervention of the well-wishers and friends.
5. In view of the above settlement the Complainant / Respondent No. 2 is not wishing to continue with the above case as against the Petitioner Nos. 1 to 6 herein.

Having regard to the fact that the parties have settled their dispute continuation of proceedings in proceedings in Crime. No. 68 of 2021 on the file of the 2nd Addl Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) & JMFC Court Davangere Dist for the offence punishable under section 506, 34, 498A, 504, 307, 323 IPC and Under section 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act., would result in abuse process of law.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. It is submitted that the Petitioners and Complainant/ Respondent No. 2 have compromised and settled the above case and they have got no further claim as against each other and also both the parties shall have no right to institute any proceedings/case before the court of law as against each other.
NC: 2024:KHC:40480 Wherefore, it is humbly prayed that, this Hon'ble court may be pleased to permit the above-named /Complainant to compound and compromise the above case in the interest or justice."
(emphasis supplied)

5. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences being punishable under Section 498A of IPC and that of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the settlement and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners.

6. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i. The Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. The proceedings in Crime No.68 of 2021 pending on the file of the 2nd Additional Civil Judge (Sr.Dn) and J.M.F.C Court, Davanagere District for offences punishable under Sections 506, 34, 498A, 504, 307, 323 of IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, NC: 2024:KHC:40480 1961, against the petitioners--  accused Nos.1 to 6, stand  quashed.
 Sd/-
